text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян hosts a holiday meetup
with her
fans, Seeing the great turnout,
Каррен Тян really
starts to feel her
popularity increasing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, on the way home, we see
people raving
about the runner who won
this year's Japanese
Oaks.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She realizes again that running well is
the best
way to show off her cuteness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Striving for the Triple Tiara, Каррен Тян
aims for
the Fillies' Revue next, a race
that's a little longer
than the distance
she's best at.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
